evidence: We introduced heterozygous loss of function, compound heterozygous, and missense residues (R276W) in iPSCs using CRISPR/Cas9.

attributes.route_or_context: CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing in human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs)
evidence: We introduced NAA15 variants into the iPSC line, personal genome project 1, using CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing

replicate_hints: Two independent iPSC lines of both wild type (WT) cells and NAA15 mutant cells
Eight samples of each genotype was collected
MS-based shotgun proteomics in at least 3 replicates for each of the 2 independent lines
multiplex_channel_hints: all ʱ- and ɛ-amines of the proteins were acetylated using 5 mM of an N-hydroxysuccinimide (NHS) ester of 13CD3-acetate

evidence: Among 5196 proteins identified by MS, extracts from NAA15+/- iPSCs, NAA15-/- iPSCs, or both revealed a total of 1209 proteins that were differentially expressed (pairwise comparison by t test) compared with WT iPSCs
